remarks: If you've been waiting for a spacious and beautiful Bemus Point home, your opportunity is here! From the moment you arrive, the grand façade of 3676 Carmen Drive makes a striking first impression, and the feeling continues as you step into the two-story foyer. With over 2,500 sq ft of living space, four bedrooms, an attached garage and an oversized yard, this home offers plenty of space inside and out. Being so close to Chautauqua Lake, you'll enjoy that unmistakable lake-life setting. The inviting floor plan features an open kitchen and living area, granite countertops, center island, abundant cabinetry and pantry, plus a formal dining room. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and private bath, while three additional bedrooms provide plenty of space for guests, a home office, hobbies or whatever suits your needs. Convenient first-floor laundry adds to the home's functionality. Downstairs, the finished basement provides even more room for movie nights, game days, hobbies or entertaining, along with additional workshop and storage space. Outside, enjoy the private backyard from the brand-new deck while taking in those gorgeous Chautauqua Lake sunsets and a peek of the lake. This home is just a short drive to the Village of Bemus Point with convenient access to I-86. With plenty of space inside and out and a location that's hard to beat, 3676 Carmen Drive is ready to welcome its next owner. Opportunities like this don't come along often - come see for yourself what makes this home truly special!
